description: This source file contains test cases for the `ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuard` component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing directory permissions and socket path validation.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketPathGuardTests
classes.description: A suite of tests verifying the correct behavior of the socket path guard, including directory creation permissions and socket file validation.

methods.name: harden parent directory creates directory with0700 permissions
methods.description: Tests that the parent directory of a socket path is created with 0700 permissions for security.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects symlink path
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to remove a socket at a symlink path is rejected with the correct error.

methods.name: remove existing socket rejects regular file path
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to remove a socket at a path that is a regular file is rejected with the correct error.
